title: Names used by batch p2-G02-2 (DNSBL lookups, keyless anonymizer votes, honeypot intelligence)

attributes.dnsbl_listings: list of per-list DNSBL answers {list, name, source, state (listed | not_listed | refused | error | test_point_failed), codes, meanings, counts, route (doh | system)}; query names carrying an access key are never kept
attributes.dnsbl_summary: one line 'listed on k of n queried lists (names, return codes)' plus the lists that could not be verified (every DNSBL is ONE 'spam' family vote)
attributes.dnsbl_not_queried: ONE coverage line naming the DNSBLs that refuse public resolvers and were not queried (needs DQS key/registration)
attributes.httpbl: Project Honey Pot http:BL answer {threat_score (0-255, log-scaled), score_band, days_since_last_activity, visitor_types, search_engine}
attributes.anonymizer_votes: VPN/proxy/hosting votes of independent keyless providers {line, answered, asked, providers, could_not_verify, deduplicated, need, inconclusive, categories {vpn|proxy|hosting: {voters, values, agreeing, true, verdict}}}; a verdict needs >= 3 agreeing answers
attributes.honeypot_sightings: list of honeypot sightings of the IP {source, first_seen, last_seen, services, tags, cves, kev, attack, sensors, networks, hits, confidence, transport, decay, counts_for_verdict}
attributes.honeypot_cve_activity: exploitation attempts of the CVE seen by honeypot networks {source, window, source_ips, kev, actively_exploited, events, unique_ips, patterns, top_asns, first_seen, last_seen}
attributes.honeypot_asn_activity: attacking addresses of the AS seen by honeypot networks {source, window, ips, hits, tags, cves}
attributes.honeypot_relayed_lists: third-party lists a honeypot provider relays for the IP (display only, never a vote of that provider: P171)

tags.vpn: VPN endpoint or exit (anonymizer context for CR28): traffic from many users, never malicious on its own
tags.hosting: hosting/datacenter address (context for CR28 anonymized infrastructure), never malicious on its own

relations.attempted_exploit: IP -> CVE the address was seen trying to exploit against honeypots (an attempt by the source: never has_vuln, the attacker is not the vulnerable host)
relations.exploit_attempted_by: CVE -> source IP seen trying to exploit it against honeypots (top actors of a honeypot network)
relations.observed_technique: IP -> ATT&CK technique observed in its honeypot sessions (behaviour of the address, not attribution to an actor)
